documents.text: To reset your password, open account settings and request a password reset link.
Enable two-factor authentication in account security settings.
Invoices are created at the end of each monthly billing cycle.
Refund requests are reviewed within five business days.
Create and rotate API keys in the developer console.
The API returns a rate limit response when callers send too many requests.
